entities.summary: Konispol is the southernmost town in Albania. It sits one kilometer away from the Albanian-Greek border. The settlement is inhabited by Cham Albanians. Konispol is the modern centre of the Cham Albanian community in Albania. The main economic interests of Konispol are agriculture and viticulture.
